subject.title: improve(gateway): bound visible history page reads

question: Should the gateway owners retain this as a separate child PR after https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/110374 lands, or fold its visible-history cursor contract into that parent stack?
rationale: The change is technically scoped but depends on the parent’s generation state and changes a gateway continuation-token contract, so stack ownership and final API shape require a human decision.

options.title: Land parent, then rebase child
options.body: Merge the generation-cursor foundation first and refresh this PR’s proof and compatibility tests against current main before reviewing it for merge.

options.title: Fold the follow-up into the parent
options.body: Combine the visible HTTP/SSE adoption with the generation-cursor foundation if owners want one reviewed cursor-contract change.

options.title: Pause the visible-reader rollout
options.body: Keep the existing bounded projection behavior until owners decide that opaque HTTP cursor output is the desired public contract.

recommendation.title: Land parent, then rebase child
recommendation.body: Merge the generation-cursor foundation first and refresh this PR’s proof and compatibility tests against current main before reviewing it for merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged projection and bounded-history foundation connected to this follow-up was introduced in the adjacent history work.
